title: RITE: Evaluating End-to-End Resilience to Silent Tool Errors in E-Commerce Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly answer e-commerce queries through multi-step tool interactions. The expected output of a tool call can shift between agent development and execution, allowing a plausible but incorrect value to be returned without an explicit failure signal. These silent errors may propagate through subsequent decisions into final answers. To study agents' resilience across this end-to-end process, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, an interactive task that evaluates whether they complete the original query after a silent error corrupts an intermediate state. We introduce RITE, a benchmark built from human-authored industrial workflows and production-log-derived inputs. To enable controlled and reproducible evaluation, we use a semantic error taxonomy to inject errors into fixed workflow prefixes, freeze recorded tool behavior, and let agents continue freely. translated_title: RITE：评估电商智能体系统对静默工具错误的端到端韧性
translated_abstract: 使用工具的LLM智能体越来越多地通过多步工具交互来回答电商查询。工具调用的预期输出可能会在智能体开发与执行之间发生变化，导致返回一个看似合理但实际不正确的值，而没有任何明确的失败信号。这些静默错误可能通过后续决策传播，最终影响答案。为了研究智能体在这一端到端过程中的韧性，我们提出了“静默错误韧性任务”（Silent-error Resilience Task），这是一个交互式任务，评估智能体在静默错误破坏中间状态后是否仍能完成原始查询。我们引入RITE，一个基于人类编写的工业工作流和生产日志派生输入构建的基准。为实现可控且可复现的评估，我们使用语义错误分类法将错误注入固定的工作流前缀，冻结已记录的工具行为，并让智能体自由地继续执行。该基准包含跨越九个电商领域的167个匹配单元。
tldr: 该论文提出了RITE基准，基于真实工业工作流与生产日志，通过注入静默工具错误并冻结历史工具行为，评估电商LLM智能体在中间状态被破坏后的端到端恢复能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RITE, a benchmark built from real industrial workflows and production logs that evaluates the end-to-end resilience of e-commerce LLM agents by injecting silent tool errors, freezing recorded tool behavior, and testing whether agents can still complete the original query.
